 def ik(self,p,R,q=None):
  q=self.s.targets.copy() if q is None else q.copy()
  self.k.qpos[:]=self.d.qpos
  for _ in range(150):
   self.k.qpos[self.s._jq]=q;mujoco.mj_forward(self.m,self.k)
   ep=p-self.k.xpos[self.pid];er=Rot.from_matrix(R@self.k.xmat[self.pid].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec()

   mujoco.mj_jacBody(self.m,self.k,self.jp,self.jr,self.pid)
   J=np.r_[self.jp[:,:7],self.jr[:,:7]*.3]
   dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.eye(6)*1e-5,e)
   q[:7]=np.clip(q[:7]+dq*np.minimum(1,.15/max(abs(dq))),self.s.lower[:7],self.s.upper[:7])

 def __init__(self,s,horizon=15):
  self.s=s;self.m=s.model;self.d=mujoco.MjData(self.m);self.horizon=horizon

 def rollout(self,q):
  mujoco.mj_setState(self.m,self.d,self.st,self.spec);self.d.ctrl[self.s._act]=q;mujoco.mj_forward(self.m,self.d)

  return self.d.xpos[self.s._obj].copy(),self.d.xmat[self.s._obj].reshape(3,3).copy()
 def optimize(self,goal,it=2,eps=.008,limit=.10):
  mujoco.mj_getState(self.m,self.s.data,self.st,self.spec)
  q=self.s.targets.copy();qref=q.copy();Rg=Rot.from_quat(goal[3:]).as_matrix()
  # Object pose tracking plus modest control change penalty
  def err(p,R):return np.r_[goal[:3]-p,Rot.from_matrix(Rg@R.T).as_rotvec()*.07]
  def cost(p,R,q):return np.linalg.norm(err(p,R))**2+.00005*np.linalg.norm(q-qref)**2
  for k in range(it):

   e[:3]*=min(1,.025/max(np.linalg.norm(e[:3]),1e-8));e[3:]*=min(1,.018/max(np.linalg.norm(e[3:]),1e-8))
   J=np.zeros((6,29))
   for j in range(29):

    J[:,j]=np.r_[p-p0,Rot.from_matrix(R@R0.T).as_rotvec()*.07]/delta
   dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.eye(6)*.00002,e)
